previous.observation: Actually viewed new raw, white/black QA and original source master guide. Front-facing open single-fill dark eyes, tiny closed mouth, image-left raised curled-index hand and image-right outward lower curled hand, crossed stance/shoes follow original source. Anatomical LEFT root correctly projects to viewer-right in this front view, unlike the separately user-rejected right-facing G12-20 profile. New broad connected gray/mint coil is compact near ear/shoulder with flat rendering and no white reflective stripe or old shaded underside panel. Cap/leaves, bob, neck, black collar, red bow, frills/cuffs/apron and two gestures form one coherent whole drawing; no normal-alpha colored fragments on either QA background. Current source gesture preserved rather than AI-video expression. Static candidate only, first-clip F845..848 placement and continuous hair/body changes remain unverified.
